general.summary: A suspected China-nexus espionage group tracked as Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221) has been exploiting a VMware vCenter zero-day since at least early September, more than two months before Broadcom released a fix, Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) revealed. The vulnerability (CVE-2026-123890) carries a CVSS score of 9.8 and allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to obtain an administrator session on vCenter Server, which organizations use to manage their VMware servers and virtual machines. Broadcom fixed it … More → The post VMware vCenter zero-day exploited for months before patch (CVE-2026-123890) appeared first on Help Net Security .

general.summary: A flaw in KVM, the hypervisor built into the Linux kernel, let researchers read about 127 GB of a cloud server's memory from inside a virtual machine of their own on DigitalOcean. On a shared server, that memory can include other customers' virtual machines. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-99312, affects only hosts with AMD processors and nested virtualization enabled. Fixed kernels shipped
general.title: Linux KVM Flaw CVE-2026-99312 Lets Guest VMs Access Host Memory on AMD Hosts

general.summary: Threat actors have been observed exploiting a recently disclosed critical security flaw in Cisco Expressway to breach a Russian organization shortly after the public release of a proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit. general.summary: CyberNewsは11月18日（現地時間）、20カ国以上に設置されたWindows搭載POS（販売時点情報管理）端末700台超がマルウェアに感染し、100万件以上のクレジットカードやデビットカードの情報が流出したと報じた。攻撃には、2024年12月に修正済みのWindowsの脆弱性「CVE-2024-49138」が悪用されていた。被害はブラジルに集中しており、更新プログラムが適用されていないPOS端末のセキュリティリスクが浮き彫りになった。
general.title: POS端末700台超がマルウェア感染、Windowsの脆弱性悪用でカード情報100万件超が流出
